{{Top|canon=Galactic Empire's Most Wanted list}}
{{Otheruses|Most Wanted}}
{{Quote|These are the big dragfish, the ones the Empire calls imminent threats to public safety or Imperial security.|[[Arack Dostryt|Arack "Deadeye" Dostryt]]|<ref name="Hunter Code">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Most Wanted List''' existed around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and contained the names and bounties of thousands of creatures wanted by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were high on the Empire's list of most-wanted outlaws.<ref name="SOTE">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Luke Skywalker (In Imperial Guard Disguise)|link=soteKluke.asp}}</ref> At some point, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]], known as the "[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]" was number six on the list.<ref name="Prince">{{WEGCite|story=The Pirate Prince (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> [[Celia Durasha]] earned a spot on the list after her actions trying to help the Alliance agent [[Detien Kaileel]] aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="CB" />
